<documents>
<document id="disputes-ach">
DisputingˆanˆACHˆdebitˆAnˆACHˆdebitˆisˆwhenˆaˆcompanyˆpullsˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumber,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆutilityˆbillˆorˆaˆloanˆpayment.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆACHˆdebitsˆIfˆaˆcompanyˆtookˆmoneyˆyouˆdidn'tˆauthorize,ˆreportˆitˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆIˆdidn'tˆauthorizeˆthis.ˆ##ˆAuthorized,ˆbutˆwrongˆIfˆyouˆdidˆauthorizeˆtheˆcompanyˆbutˆtheˆamountˆorˆdateˆisˆwrong,ˆcontactˆtheˆcompanyˆfirst.ˆIfˆthatˆdoesn'tˆwork,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆitˆwithˆyou.ˆ##ˆStoppingˆfutureˆdebitsˆYouˆcanˆblockˆaˆcompanyˆfromˆpullingˆmoneyˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆBlockˆfutureˆdebits.ˆTellˆtheˆcompanyˆtoo,ˆsoˆtheyˆknowˆtoˆbillˆyouˆanotherˆway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWe'llˆaskˆtheˆcompany'sˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney.ˆIfˆyourˆclaimˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆACHˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆandˆBrookPayˆpayments,ˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputedˆthisˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-returned">
ReturnedˆtransfersˆSometimesˆaˆtransferˆisˆsentˆback.ˆThisˆisˆcalledˆaˆreturn.ˆItˆusuallyˆhappensˆaˆfewˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆtheˆtransferˆwasˆsent.ˆ##ˆCommonˆreasonsˆ-ˆTheˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆroutingˆnumberˆwasˆwrong.ˆ-ˆTheˆreceivingˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆorˆfrozen.ˆ-ˆTheˆnameˆonˆtheˆreceivingˆaccountˆdidn'tˆmatch.ˆ-ˆForˆmoneyˆyouˆpulledˆinˆfromˆanotherˆbank,ˆthereˆwasn'tˆenoughˆmoneyˆinˆthatˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆmoneyˆForˆtransfersˆout,ˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆbackˆtoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆbalanceˆwhenˆtheˆreturnˆreachesˆus.ˆForˆtransfersˆin,ˆweˆtakeˆbackˆanyˆamountˆweˆalreadyˆmadeˆavailable.ˆ##ˆFeesˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆforˆreturnedˆtransfersˆ($0.00).ˆTheˆotherˆbankˆmight.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆCheckˆtheˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆlinkedˆaccount,ˆcorrectˆanythingˆwrong,ˆandˆsendˆtheˆtransferˆagain.ˆIfˆaˆpullˆfromˆyourˆownˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbankˆwasˆreturned,ˆaskˆthatˆbankˆwhyˆbeforeˆyouˆtryˆagain.ˆRepeatedˆreturnsˆcanˆleadˆtoˆlowerˆtransferˆamounts.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="overdraft-no-fees">
Doˆyouˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfees?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆorˆnon-sufficientˆfundsˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆinsteadˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆhaveˆenoughˆmoney,ˆtheˆtransactionˆisˆsimplyˆdeclined.ˆThere'sˆnoˆchargeˆforˆaˆdecline.ˆ##ˆCushionˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆturnˆonˆCushion,ˆwhichˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆwhenˆyourˆbalanceˆrunsˆshort,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆCushionˆcoversˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ$200ˆonˆPremium.ˆItˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCanˆmyˆbalanceˆstillˆgoˆnegative?ˆRarely.ˆItˆcanˆhappenˆwhenˆaˆmerchantˆchargesˆmoreˆthanˆitˆfirstˆauthorized,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆtipˆaddedˆtoˆaˆrestaurantˆbill,ˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆpaymentsˆIfˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆorˆanˆACHˆdebitˆcan'tˆbeˆpaid,ˆit'sˆreturnedˆunpaid,ˆwithˆnoˆfeeˆfromˆus.ˆTheˆcompanyˆyouˆoweˆmayˆchargeˆitsˆownˆlateˆfee.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
